question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
-- Let me verify: 12 delivered pizza rows. 
-- Pizza 1 has toppings: 1,2,3,4,5,6,8,10 (8 toppings)
-- Pizza 2 has toppings: 4,6,7,9,11,12 (6 toppings)
-- 
-- From the delivered orders:
-- Pizza 1 appears: orders 1,2,3,4,4,5,8,10,10 = 9 times
-- Pizza 2 appears: orders 3,4,7 = 3 times
--
-- Pizza 1 toppings: 9 * 8 = 72 topping instances
-- Pizza 2 toppings: 3 * 6 = 18 topping instances
-- Total: 90
--
-- Let me verify the counts per topping:
-- Cheese (4): appears in both pizza 1 and pizza 2 => 9 + 3 = 12 ✓
-- Mushrooms (6): appears in both pizza 1 and pizza 2 => 9 + 3 = 12 ✓
-- BBQ Sauce (2): only pizza 1 => 9 ✓
-- Bacon (1): only pizza 1 => 9 ✓
-- Beef (3): only pizza 1 => 9 ✓
-- Chicken (5): only pizza 1 => 9 ✓
-- Pepperoni (8): only pizza 1 => 9 ✓
-- Salami (10): only pizza 1 => 9 ✓
-- Onions (7): only pizza 2 => 3 ✓
-- Peppers (9): only pizza 2 => 3 ✓
-- Tomato Sauce (12): only pizza 2 => 3 ✓
-- Tomatoes (11): only pizza 2 => 3 ✓
-- Total: 12+12+9+9+9+9+9+9+3+3+3+3 = 90 ✓

-- The query is correct. Let me submit.
SELECT 
    pt.topping_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_quantity
FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
    AND (ro.cancellation IS NULL OR ro.cancellation = '')
JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON co.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(pr.toppings, ', ')) AS t(topping_id) ON TRUE
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON pt.topping_id = TRY_CAST(t.topping_id AS BIGINT)
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, pt.topping_name
